name: 𝐑𝐨𝐬𝐚 𝐎𝐬𝐭𝐞𝐫𝐥𝐢𝐧𝐠
headline: Embodied Leadership & Emotional Intelligence Coach for High-Value Individuals and Teams | Transforming Confidence, Communication, Performance & Culture
bio:
For over two decades, I’ve helped leaders, executives, and high-performing individuals elevate the way they lead, communicate, and connect — both professionally and personally.

My career began in global seminar operations, partnering with internationally recognized brands such as Robert Kiyosaki’s Rich Dad organization, Kane Minkus’ Industry Rockstar, and later as a Results Coach for Tony Robbins, where I was selected as one of only 26 coaches from more than 1,200 applicants worldwide.

Since then, I’ve coached organizations and private clients across industries — including Itaú Bank, Deloitte, Direct Wines, and Good Apple — as well as professionals in real estate, finance, law, education, automotive, and entertainment. Many of my high-profile and celebrity clients choose to remain confidential.

What I Do
▪ Redefine identity so leaders can lead with clarity, confidence, and calm authority
▪ Create balance that fuels performance instead of draining it
▪ Strengthen communication and culture to build trust, retention, and collaboration
▪ Support powerful relationships — in business and in life — that actually last

Why Clients Choose Me
▪ Depth + Results — My framework blends psychology, strategy, and embodiment through The Three Codes™: Identity, Balance, and Relationships — the foundation of fulfillment and performance.
▪ Discretion + Safety — My clients include executives, entrepreneurs, and public figures who value a private space to speak freely. Every conversation is confidential, judgment-free, and designed to protect both brand and humanity.
▪ Proven Impact — From corporate leaders to creatives, clients experience sustainable transformation — within themselves, their teams, and their results.

This isn’t about quick fixes. It’s about becoming the kind of leader whose presence elevates everything and everyone around them.

If you’re ready to strengthen confidence, communication, and culture — in your leadership or your life — send a private message to explore alignment.

With Gratitude, 

Rosa.
